mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index over the next 20 trading days signals deflationary expectations, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL doesn't decline for 20 days, or 20-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS doesn't decline for 60 days, or returns aren't significantly higher (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers a tightening labor market, increasing policy rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE doesn't cross above 5% in the 3-month window, or returns aren't significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly demand (HOUST) and demand growth (RSAFS) signals robust economic activity, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the proxies don't move in the same direction for 5 days, or returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate signals higher policy rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS doesn't rise in the tightening cycle context, or returns aren't significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index over the next 60 trading days signals weakening supply capacity, driving up inflation expectations and boosting S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO doesn't decline for 60 days, or returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 135,000 triggers a labor market expansion, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 135,000 in the next month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS doesn't cross above 135,000 in the next month, or returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a combination of falling federal funds rates and rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth signals a favorable macro environment, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the interaction doesn't occur during a late-cycle expansion, or returns aren't significantly positive (p>0.05).
